turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patil? This is Inspector Vikram Rathore from the Narcotics Control Bureau office in Bengaluru.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Patil. What is this about? Why are you calling me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, we have intercepted a courier package containing banned substances and your Aadhaar number was found linked to the sender's profile.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? That is impossible. I have never sent any such package in my life.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Listen carefully, this is a serious criminal matter. If you hang up or tell anyone, we will have to initiate a digital arrest and send a team to your house immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Digital arrest? I do not understand. Please, I am a retired man, let me explain everything.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can help you clear your name, but you must stay on this line for the entire verification process. Do not talk to your family or they will be implicated too.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: My family? Why would they be involved? This is very stressful, please tell me what to do.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The legal department has agreed to a provisional clearance. You just need to deposit twenty five thousand rupees into our secure verification account to prove your identity.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I have to pay money? I thought this was a police matter, why do I need to pay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is a refundable security deposit, Mr. Patil. If you don't transfer it in ten minutes, I will be forced to issue the arrest warrant.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Ten minutes is not enough time, I have to find my glasses and the banking app.
